selection_rule: Failed-tail retry only: the sole missing item from the verified 61-75-page tranche; 18 completed item folders are excluded.
failure_signature: Exact catalogue-declared PDM/open IIIF v2 manifest returned HTTP 403; retry uses only documented official Wellcome IIIF presentation version variants and never bypasses access controls.

constraints.rights: Recheck exact item location PDM and open access before retrieval.
constraints.retrieval: Anonymous official Wellcome API/IIIF only; documented v2/v3/content-negotiated presentation endpoints only; no access-control bypass.
constraints.preservation: Every page, raw work metadata and actual retrieved manifest, hashes, Drive fingerprint readback, checkpoint and COMPLETE.
constraints.capacity_gate: One failed-tail item only; do not rerun or redownload the 18 verified items.
